title: Creamy Lemon Chicken Pasta
description: Silky lemon cream sauce, tender chicken, and pasta for an easy weeknight favorite.
instructions: Cook pasta in salted water until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water, then drain.
Season chicken with salt and pepper. Sear in olive oil until golden and cooked through.
Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Stir in cream, lemon zest, and juice.
Add Parmesan and pasta. Toss until glossy, adding pasta water as needed. Serve warm.

title: Smashed Avocado Toast
description: Creamy avocado, crisp toast, chili flakes, and a bright squeeze of lemon.
instructions: Toast the sourdough until crisp and golden.
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Spread over toast and finish with chili flakes and olive oil.

title: Honey Garlic Salmon Bowls
description: Glazed salmon, fluffy rice, crunchy vegetables, and a simple honey-garlic sauce.
instructions: Whisk honey, soy sauce, and garlic. Brush over salmon.
Bake salmon at 400°F for 12–15 minutes, brushing once more halfway through.
Build bowls with rice, salmon, cucumber, and carrot. Drizzle with remaining glaze.

title: Greek Yogurt Berry Parfait
description: Layers of creamy yogurt, juicy berries, crunchy granola, and honey.
instructions: Spoon yogurt into two glasses.
Add berries and granola in layers.
Drizzle with honey and serve immediately.

title: One-Bowl Chocolate Cake
description: A rich, tender chocolate cake with minimal cleanup and maximum chocolate flavor.
instructions: Heat oven to 350°F and grease a 9-inch cake pan.
Whisk dry ingredients. Add eggs, milk, oil, and vanilla; mix until smooth.
Stir in hot coffee. Pour into pan and bake 30–35 minutes.
Cool before slicing and serving.

title: Cozy Garden Vegetable Soup
description: A hearty vegetable soup packed with beans, herbs, and comforting flavor.
instructions: Sauté onion, carrots, and celery in olive oil for 5 minutes.
Add broth, tomatoes, beans, and seasoning. Bring to a boil.
Simmer 20 minutes until vegetables are tender. Season to taste.
